description: Delete a chart annotation people added (source databuddy) from dashboard charts, including public charts if shared; GitHub markers are read-only. Applying marks it deleted; no restore tool is exposed. Preview returns the annotation.

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. annotation contains its text, type, time coordinates, tags, color, public visibility and source with its GitHub link; saved results also include ID and update time; success confirms an applied mutation.
